summary: All seven Unreal Chaos rigid-baseline D6 fixtures now run through real simulated physics actors and produce merge-valid telemetry. The independent compliant-reference target and manual review remain missing.

correction.previous_claim: The earlier UE measured export was described as closing both D6 targets.
correction.finding: Both earlier passes used the same custom C++ D1-D4 implementation, with the second pass selecting its analytical RigidBaseline mode. It was neither a Project Chrono/reviewed compliant model nor an Unreal Chaos simulation.
correction.action: Reclassified physics/reports/d6/ue as translation diagnostics and corrected the release plan. No previous diagnostic output is used to satisfy an independent D6 target.

runner.simulated_body: UBoxComponent with QueryAndPhysics collision and SetSimulatePhysics(true)
runner.repeat_policy: Every scenario is rerun from a fresh world and must produce the same quantized trajectory hash.

rock_pinch_wrap.interpretation: Chaos resolves a rigid contact but cannot wrap; the zero wrap result is an intentional baseline delta.

timed_high_side_save.interpretation: The same force probe produces a smaller rigid-body roll response when the recorded high-side crew torque is applied.

rigid_capability_deltas.interpretation: Required zero-valued metrics record unsupported rigid-proxy capabilities; they are not synthetic compliant answers.

measurement_limits: The Chaos target is intentionally a single rigid proxy. It is not a production flexible raft and cannot satisfy the compliant target.
Contact indentation and impulse fields are fixture-space sphere/box geometry plus velocity-residual estimates around genuine Chaos advancement, not a raw exported Chaos manifold/impulse callback.
Uniform-water inputs become external force and torque probes because Chaos does not own the custom water or retained-volume model.
Runtime CPU values are measured in the headless editor and are not a target-platform performance qualification.
No visual overlay is claimed; the accepted evidence is numerical telemetry and physics-handle provenance.
remaining_gates: Run all seven fixtures in Project Chrono or another independently reviewed compliant model.
Validate and merge the compliant sidecar without substituting the custom C++ port or Python reference.
Regenerate the two-target D6 comparison report.
Complete manual physics, Unreal integration, deterministic replay, and guide/safety gameplay review.
Keep scoring-critical runtime authority on CustomReducedRigidBody unless the separate Chaos/Jolt authority suite selects a replacement.
